sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: At Peru Grand Travel, we are committed to sustainable tourism through our tourist landscape cleanup campaigns. We promote environmental awareness by organizing regular trail clean-ups and hikes. These actions not only preserve the natural beauty of our landscapes, but also generate a positive impact on the local community. We engage residents and visitors in active conservation of the environment, creating a meaningful connection with nature and fostering a lasting commitment to caring for the planet. Learn more about our social projects .

PGT Cleanup Campaign, each cleanup action is an opportunity to preserve and raise awareness about the importance of caring for our landscapes. Together, we are creating a conservation legacy that goes beyond a simple visit, fostering a deep respect for nature and truly responsible tourism.
